name: Funkelregen
source:
From the beginning, man looked up to the stars, tried to grasp them with bare hands, and wondered what lies hidden on the almost endless amount of worlds out there... 

But 400 years in the future, the galaxy lies within humanity's reach - endless wonders await you... Giant space stations on the Iron Line, the cyberpunk-dystopias of Lyrea and Kassiopeia, the waters of Vessella, the scorching deserts of Heretic's Boulder, or the frozen plains of Forgestar Secondus.

What will you do with the galaxy at your feet? Become the unfliching defender of the galaxy, master of time and space or simply find true love(s)...?

But the darkness between the stars can be a dangerous place... gladly you're not alone...
